publication_type: bilingual dedicated dossier plus cross-site legal/evidential separation module

controlling_proposition.es: No existe un único retracto: DP1041/art.1535 sobre crédito, el trabajo jurídico de 2018 sobre unidades, el retracto de comuneros y los posibles derechos contractuales/turísticos/de explotación son vías distintas y deben analizarse operación por operación.
controlling_proposition.en: There is no single retracto: PP1041/Article1535 credit assignment, the documented 2018 unit-rights workstream, co-owner retracto and any contractual/tourism/exploitation rights are distinct tracks and must be analysed transaction by transaction.

legal_controls.law5_1999: Paragraph 4 of the sole transitional provision was investigated by counsel historically but was not an operative 2018 basis; Law 2/2000 had removed it and STC 28/2012 declared it unconstitutional and null.
legal_controls.art1522_1524: Candidate only for genuine same-property undivided co-ownership and sale to an outsider; nine-day statutory period must be tested from registration or actual knowledge.
legal_controls.art396: No generic tanteo/retracto arises merely because owners hold separate flats/locals in the same horizontal-property regime.
legal_controls.dp1041_appeal: The 15-Feb-2018 Commercial Court order provided a 20-day appeal under Article 97 bis.2 LC; five-day remedies belong to distinct later procedural acts.

evidence_controls.rtb: Separate May-June 2018 unit-rights legal workstream is directly documented; enforceable right remains transaction-specific.
evidence_controls.finca8500: Priority Article 1522 candidate because 2016 title material records pro-indiviso ownership; no merits conclusion yet.
evidence_controls.finca8706: CAM 100% acquisition under 27-Dec-2017 protocol 2715 is controlled; seller identity remains P0 until operative deed closure.
evidence_controls.finca8718: Pre-CAM Tengolf/Amenemhat split and May-2018 CAM acquisition sequence are controlled; legal-right analysis remains open.
evidence_controls.ac_causation: DP1041 C5 applies only to the end of Cristo's specific formal LPB mandate and does not automatically transfer to unit/property rights.

p0: Protocol 2741 / fincas 8499-8500 authority and title chain
Protocol 2715 / finca 8706 seller and prior title
Any actual unit-rights filing or draft from May-June 2018
Fresh AC knowledge/control/causation analysis for each established right
